target_orientation.note: Orientation only. This fixture contains no target source and reproduces no target stylesheet. Target constructs informed which cases are worth carrying; they were not copied. Exact target commit and tree identities are recorded in the phase's private inventory evidence rather than here.
target_orientation.scope_note: Counts below cover BOTH the twelve authored stylesheets and the four host-component <style> regions. Where the two differ the difference is stated, because several constructs occur only in the regions.

website.css_relevance: one SVG embedded style region with a media query; no whole-file stylesheet

observed_in_stylesheets: one cascade layer established at the stylesheet entry point
custom properties defined and referenced across files
thirty media blocks: width, two user-preference features, and one bare print media type
colour mixing and perceptual colour functions
twenty-one flow-relative declarations with no writing-mode declaration anywhere
keyframes, animation, transitions, and vendor-prefixed declarations
theme.embedded_css_semantics: Nine style attributes contain CSS declarations. Three fill and one stroke SVG presentation attributes map to CSS properties at author origin with specificity zero and without !important grammar. Markup and SVG owners retain whole-file authority.

tool_roles.framework-selected: Astro 7.1.3 selects Vite 8.1.5; Vite's default CSS transformer is PostCSS and its production CSS minifier is Lightning CSS
tool_roles.transformer: selected-by-framework; exact invocation and output unobserved
tool_roles.basis: The build script selects Astro and the documented Astro/Vite pipeline establishes framework selection. Transitive package presence alone would not. No target build ran, so invocation and output are not claimed.

cases.purpose: Ordinary authored stylesheet with its exact recovery boundaries.
cases.decision_scope: What each declaration and rule in an authored stylesheet means, and which unit a malformed construct discards.
present_evidence: exact fixture source bytes
artifact class and whole-file owner
question-specific CSS syntax and selectors normative modules
required_evidence: exact parser package and version before any parse-result claim
exact user agent only before an implementation or availability claim
cases.owned_conclusion: The recovery unit differs by construct: the grammar-invalid padding value drops its own declaration, while a malformed selector list discards the whole rule.
cases.nonowned_conclusion: Whether any selector matches an element, and whether any declaration renders.
cases.rollback_or_provenance: APG-authored fixture; prior bytes are the committed file and its provenance is the APG76 commit.
cases.expected_authoring_boundary: APG76 authored two distinct recovery boundaries in one file and asserted no parser output.

cases.decision_scope: How functional pseudo-classes change a selector's specificity, and how a same-specificity pair resolves by source order.
present_evidence: exact selector text of every competing rule, including :is(), :not(), and :where() forms
relative source order within one stylesheet
selected selectors module level
required_evidence: every other participating stylesheet before a cross-file winner is named
cases.owned_conclusion: :is() and :not() take their most specific argument's specificity, :where() contributes zero, and equal specificity resolves by later source order.
cases.nonowned_conclusion: Which elements these selectors reach, and whether the resolved value is visible.
cases.rollback_or_provenance: APG-authored fixture; the competing rules are colocated so a change is reversible within one file.
cases.expected_authoring_boundary: APG76 wrote competing selectors of equal reach and different specificity and asserted no matched element.

cases.purpose: Cascade layer ordering for normal and important declarations.
cases.decision_scope: How layered and unlayered declarations of the same selector and specificity order, separately for normal and important.
present_evidence: explicit layer statement establishing layer order
layered and unlayered declarations of the same property
importance flag on each competing declaration
required_evidence: layer names contributed by any other stylesheet or import in the graph
origin of every participating declaration when more than one origin exists
cases.owned_conclusion: Unlayered normal declarations sit in an implicit final layer and win, while important declarations reverse that order so unlayered important is weakest in its origin.
cases.nonowned_conclusion: The user-agent and user origin declarations that may also participate.
cases.rollback_or_provenance: APG-authored fixture; the layer statement is the single point that fixes order, so a change is localized.
cases.expected_authoring_boundary: APG76 fixed layer order explicitly rather than relying on appearance order across files.

cases.decision_scope: How inherit, initial, and unset differ on one inherited and one non-inherited property under the same ancestor.
present_evidence: ancestor declaration for one inherited and one non-inherited property
descendant declarations using each CSS-wide keyword
per-property inheritance behavior and initial value from the owning module
required_evidence: the previous origin or layer result before revert or revert-layer is answerable
cases.owned_conclusion: unset resolves as inherit for the inherited property and as initial for the non-inherited one, so the inherit and unset descendants agree on the inherited property and diverge on the other.
cases.nonowned_conclusion: The document tree that determines which element is the parent.
cases.rollback_or_provenance: APG-authored fixture; ancestor and descendant declarations are colocated.
cases.expected_authoring_boundary: APG76 chose a non-inherited property whose initial value does not depend on the inherited one, so inherit and unset do not accidentally agree; and wrote no revert or revert-layer case, because a sound one needs a second origin the fixture does not supply.

cases.decision_scope: What a shorthand does to true longhands of its own family that the author did not mention, in both declaration orders.
present_evidence: shorthand and physical-longhand declarations in both orders
the shorthand's exact longhand family from the box module
required_evidence: declarations of the same longhands in any other participating stylesheet
cases.owned_conclusion: The shorthand assigns every longhand in its own family, so an earlier longhand of that family is reset and only the later order preserves it.
cases.nonowned_conclusion: The used value the reset longhand ultimately produces.
cases.rollback_or_provenance: APG-authored fixture; both orders are present so the contrast survives an edit to either.
cases.expected_authoring_boundary: APG76 used only physical longhands here. A flow-relative property is deliberately excluded: it is not a longhand of this shorthand but a member of a logical property group, and it belongs to APG76-FX-010.

cases.decision_scope: When a var() reference substitutes a defined value, when it takes the fallback, and how an empty custom property differs from an undefined one.
present_evidence: custom-property definitions on the ancestor
referencing declarations with and without a fallback
an empty custom-property definition
required_evidence: the element whose inherited custom-property environment applies
any redefinition of the same custom property elsewhere in the cascade
cases.owned_conclusion: The fallback is everything after the first comma; an empty value is valid and substitutes nothing rather than selecting the fallback.
cases.nonowned_conclusion: Which element carries the inherited definitions at render time.
cases.rollback_or_provenance: APG-authored fixture; definitions and references are colocated so the referencing chain is auditable.
cases.expected_authoring_boundary: APG76 separated the undefined case from the empty case rather than treating both as absent.

cases.purpose: Custom-property cycle and invalid at computed-value time.
cases.decision_scope: What a reference into a cycle and a valid-but-wrong substitution do to the referencing declaration.
present_evidence: a two-property custom-property cycle
a custom property whose value is invalid for the target property
an earlier declaration of the same property
required_evidence: whether the referenced custom property is registered and with which syntax, inheritance flag, and initial value
cases.owned_conclusion: Both failures make the declaration invalid at computed-value time, which behaves as unset rather than restoring the earlier declaration.
cases.nonowned_conclusion: The rendered colour that results from that computation.
cases.rollback_or_provenance: APG-authored fixture; the cycle is confined to one rule so it can be broken without touching other cases.
cases.expected_authoring_boundary: APG76 wrote an earlier declaration next to the failing one so the non-restoring result is observable.

cases.decision_scope: What is statically answerable about a conditional at-rule when its condition's truth is not.
present_evidence: conditional at-rule structure and contained declarations
a dimensional query, a preference query, an unknown feature, an unknown value, a grammar-invalid query, a negated unknown feature, comma-list recovery, and a negated unknown media type
a supports condition over one declaration
required_evidence: exact viewport and user-preference values
the exact user agent whose usable declaration support the supports query tests
cases.owned_conclusion: The rule structure is static; a misspelled media feature produces unknown, does not match in the two-valued application, is not simply inverted true by negation, and does not discard valid comma-list siblings. A true supports declaration condition is stronger than token parsing but weaker than correct rendering.
cases.nonowned_conclusion: Whether either condition holds, and whether a true supports condition implies correct implementation.
cases.rollback_or_provenance: APG-authored fixture; each condition is a separate at-rule and removable on its own.
cases.expected_authoring_boundary: APG76 wrote a supports condition that the pinned targets use only inside host style regions, never in an authored stylesheet, and recorded that asymmetry rather than flattening it.

cases.decision_scope: What a nested rule resolves to when its parent selector list has members of different specificity.
present_evidence: a parent selector list with a class and an ID member
nested rules with an explicit, an implied, and a leading-combinator form
an unnested rule written for contrast
required_evidence: whether the project's source level and toolchain accept nesting at all
cases.owned_conclusion: Each nested rule resolves against the parent list as one unit, so its specificity follows the most specific parent member.
cases.nonowned_conclusion: Whether any consumer parses nesting, and how a transformer would flatten it.
cases.rollback_or_provenance: APG-authored fixture; the unnested contrast rule makes a flattening change reviewable.
cases.expected_authoring_boundary: APG76 made the parent list heterogeneous so the specificity consequence is not hidden by a uniform parent.

cases.purpose: Units, math functions, and the logical/physical property boundary.
cases.decision_scope: Which value expressions reduce statically, which need a reference this profile does not own, and how a flow-relative property relates to its physical counterpart and to the physical shorthand.
present_evidence: an absolute font-size declaration selected on the same element as the local font-relative lengths
math functions with absolute, local-font-relative, root-font-relative, percentage, and viewport operands
a flow-relative declaration paired with its physical counterpart
required_evidence: the root element's computed font-size for every root font-relative operand
the containing block for every percentage reference
the viewport for every viewport-relative operand
writing mode, direction, and text orientation before any logical/physical outcome
cases.owned_conclusion: An expression reduces statically only when every operand's reference is bound: the local arithmetic reduces only when the same element matches both .metric and .metric--computed, while root font-relative, percentage, and viewport operands remain unresolved.
cases.nonowned_conclusion: The physical side each flow-relative property maps to, the shared computed value of the pair, and every used value.
cases.rollback_or_provenance: APG-authored fixture; resolvable and unresolvable expressions are in separate rules.
cases.expected_authoring_boundary: APG76 declared the element's own font-size in absolute units so the local font-relative case is genuinely reducible, declared no root font-size so the root font-relative case is genuinely not, and declared no writing mode so the logical mapping stays required evidence.

cases.decision_scope: What currentColor resolves against, and which module level defines each colour function used.
present_evidence: a colour declaration and a currentColor reference on the same element
a currentColor reference on a descendant with a distinct descendant color
a colour-mixing function and a perceptual colour-space function
required_evidence: the cascade result for colour on the element that carries the reference
the exact user agent before any availability claim
cases.owned_conclusion: currentColor computes to the keyword and resolves at used-value time against the element's own color; the distinct descendant color carries the contrast needed to demonstrate conditional descendant re-resolution.
cases.nonowned_conclusion: Whether the colour functions are supported, and what is displayed.
cases.rollback_or_provenance: APG-authored fixture; the ancestor and descendant references are colocated.
cases.expected_authoring_boundary: APG76 used colour functions the pinned theme also uses, and still asserted no support claim.

cases.decision_scope: What may be concluded about a style region inside a host component without the host's scoping behavior.
present_evidence: the embedded region's exact declaration and selector bytes
the host file's artifact class and owner
required_evidence: the host's exact scoping transformation and the selectors it emits
whether the region is scoped or global in this host configuration
cases.owned_conclusion: The declarations inside the region are readable on their own terms, bounded to the region.
cases.nonowned_conclusion: The selectors that actually reach the cascade, their transformed specificity, and any interaction with whole-file stylesheets.
cases.rollback_or_provenance: APG-authored fixture; the host file is never executed, built, or rendered by APG76.
cases.expected_authoring_boundary: APG76 kept selection at embedded-route and took no whole-file ownership of a host artifact.

cases.purpose: Generated, vendor, and minified artifact provenance boundary.
cases.decision_scope: Whether a banner, a minified shape, or a vendor prefix establishes that an artifact is generated.
present_evidence: a banner-style provenance claim in a comment
minified formatting and a vendor-prefixed declaration
the fact that this file is hand-authored APG76 fixture source
required_evidence: the exact tool, configuration, and source that would have produced it
an owner decision on whether the artifact is regenerable
cases.owned_conclusion: A bounded read-only CSS semantic diagnosis is selected over the exact bytes. Formatting and the banner are provenance hints rather than proof, and the semantic reading confers no edit or regeneration permission.
cases.nonowned_conclusion: Whether the artifact is in fact generated, and whether it may be edited or must be regenerated.
cases.rollback_or_provenance: Hand-authored by APG76 as a representation of the class; it is not build output, and APG76 commits no build output or source map.
cases.expected_authoring_boundary: APG76 wrote no source-map reference, because one would name a build artifact the fixture must not contain.

cases.purpose: Unknown parser, browser, and render state.
cases.decision_scope: What remains unanswerable when every tool role and environment input is unbound.
present_evidence: source-level grammar forms depending on viewport, containing block, writing mode, user agent, and document state
the freshly pinned target's framework-selected CSS pipeline and unresolved browser state
required_evidence: exact parser package, version, and invocation
exact transformer package, version, and configuration
exact user agent and environment values
a document and its runtime state
cases.owned_conclusion: Each source form and dependency is nameable; exact parser acceptance, transformed output, rendering, and runtime consequences remain separately unproved.
cases.nonowned_conclusion: Every rendered, transformed, supported, and interactive consequence.
cases.rollback_or_provenance: APG-authored fixture; each unresolved dependency is a separate rule and is removable on its own.
cases.expected_authoring_boundary: APG76 recorded unresolved roles rather than binding a concrete parser, transformer, or browser to them.
